retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover layout featuring a soft-focus portrait under a heavy monochromatic color wash with high-contrast decorative typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman viewed through foliage, entirely tinted in a desaturated moss green. The top third is dominated by large, white decorative serif lettering with distinctive swash terminals, followed by bold black sans-serif and a list of tracks in a condensed white sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy upper quadrant balanced by a centered face
Monochromatic green wash unifying foreground foliage and subject
High contrast between white decorative text and dark green background
Visual depth created by blurred botanical elements in the extreme foreground
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Decorative swash elements on the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered female portrait, medium close-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, positioned slightly below the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white title at the top, moves down through the black secondary text, and settles on the subject's gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the blurred foliage areas provide breathing room for metadata and secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Moss green monochromatic wash across the entire image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary title and tracklist.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for the secondary artist name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-to-dark value range with high-value highlights in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Integrated decorative curls and swashes on terminals
Uniform cap height for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and H with inward-curling swash terminals
E with a curled middle bar
L with a decorative loop at the base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast decorative serif paired with a heavy, utilitarian condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Small decorative icons (stars/flowers) in the upper right corner
Circular grid logo in the lower left

preserve: The swash terminals on the main title
The condensed nature of the secondary text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Franklin Gothic Extra Condensed
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and density of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman looking directly at the camera, partially obscured by blurred green leaves in the foreground. Apply a heavy, desaturated moss-green monochromatic filter over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white title in a decorative serif font with swash terminals at the top. Below it, add a bold black condensed sans-serif name. Finally, add a list of tracks in a smaller, white condensed sans-serif on the left side.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have decorative swashes?
Is the secondary text bold and black?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles

avoid: Default modern fonts like Arial or Calibri

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography doesn't obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the decorative swashes look integrated, not added on
Confirm the 1960s vintage feel is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Tint + Soft Focus Portrait + Decorative Swash Serif + Condensed Sans-Serif Hierarchy
